error[L0103]: a variant case carries its payload after `:`, as `full: (...)`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/variant-case-payload-written-as-a-call/program.ldn:2:23

2 |     kind: variant full(n: i32) | empty end kind

  |
2 |     kind: variant full(n: i32) | empty end kind
  |                   ^^^^ the case named here
  = note: [0680]: a case is a name, followed by `:` and a parenthesized field list when it carries a payload
